# Container images of the lakehouse datastore, edited BY HAND (no bump automation).
#
# Format, one line per image (comments and blank lines are ignored; no trailing text on a line):
#   <name> <image>:<tag>@sha256:<digest>
# - name: lower case, one of the four below (the whitelist is in validate.sh).
# - tag: exact (major.minor or major.minor.patch, as the upstream project publishes it), never
#   latest and never a floating major tag such as "17" or "9-alpine".
# - digest: the manifest sha256 of the tag, the digest the registry serves for it. Check with:
#     skopeo inspect --raw docker://<image>:<tag> | sha256sum
# To change a version: edit the tag and the digest together on a feature branch, run tests/datastore-images.sh,
# open a pull request. A merge publishes a new datastore-images image; octarine-os bumps its pointer to it.
#
# Values copied from octarine-os variants/dx/datastore/datastore.env on 2026-11-15 (digests not re-checked here).
